The space is designed with an open shelving system and a mounted television, emphasizing functionality and contemporary style. The minimalist color palette of beige, black, and white complements the glossy surfaces, creating a sleek and modern look. The design avoids overt traditional elements, focusing on a clean, efficient, and culturally relevant modern Indian aesthetic.
